item.title: Rallying Cry – August 29, 2026
item.description: Sae Joon Park, a Purple Heart veteran, received a heartfelt pardon, while London's Tate Modern brings the inspiring life of Frida Kahlo to the forefront, and Céline Dion makes her long-awaited return to Paris after six years away from the stage.
